content.short: Anzens is a platform created & operated by EMURGO for users to mint crypto backed by real-world asset.
content.description: Anzens is a platform created & managed by EMURGO for users to mint crypto backed by real-world assets, for example minting digital USD in the form of USDA. Moving forward we will add more currency (e.g. EUR, JPY, GBP, etc.) as well as other real-world asset (gold, property, etc).
